Paste a link to a recipe page, or the recipe as text. A link is read by your Tandoor and a text here on the phone. You check the result before it is saved.

AI reading of a photo or PDF
A photo of a recipe (a cookbook page, a card) or a PDF is read by the AI service your Tandoor is set up with. It costs the household’s AI credits.
Your Tandoor has no AI service, so AI reading of photos and PDFs is not available. An administrator adds one under the space settings on the web.
